source_turns.text: NVIDIA reported a 7.5% sequential increase in data-centre demand.
The source describes 3.2 billion dollars of planned capacity and says the estimate is not guaranteed.
The counter-thesis: I challenge the assumption that demand will persist before every planned facility is utilized.
We are uncertain whether the reported timing will hold, and this fixture does not make an investment recommendation.
